approach:
# Extend CKgP / gonality stratification to M_6,6

## Setup and why this case appears

RED-0001 records that extending the published low-homology induction of SRC-0002 (exact sequence (6.1), proof of Theorem 1.5(3)) from even degree 14 to degree 16 reduces the unresolved pure-weight open-stratum input to the finite list M_3,12, M_5,8, M_6,6, M_7,4, and M_8,n for n=0,1,2. The present attempt treats only the single case (g,n)=(6,6) at cohomological degree k=16, by trying to push the published CKgP / gonality-stratification geometry one marking past the published bound c(6)=5.

For n>=2, Borel-Moore vanishing of H^{BM}_k(M_g,n) holds when k < 2g-2+n (SRC-0002, proof of Theorem 1.5(3), citing [4, Prop. 2.1]). At (g,n,k)=(6,6,16) one has equality 2g-2+n = 16, so W_{-16} H^{BM}_{16}(M_6,6) is a genuine base-case input to the right-exact sequence

  H_16(^\partial Mbar_6,6) -> H_16(Mbar_6,6) -> W_{-16} H^{BM}_{16}(M_6,6) -> 0.

Poincare duality identifies the dual pure-weight problem with controlling W_16 H^{16}(M_6,6) (with explicit Tate twist bookkeeping). The stack M_6,6 is never replaced by its coarse space.

## Published coverage and the precise missing mark

SRC-0002 Table 1 and SRC-0004 Lemma 10.14 give c(6)=5: M_6,n has the CKgP and A^*(M_6,n)=R^*(M_6,n) for all n<=5. Lemma 4.3 / Proposition 4.5 of SRC-0002 then yield W_k H^k(M_6,n)=RH^k(M_6,n) for n<=5, in particular pure Hodge-Tate for even k. The n=6 column is absent from the published table; that is exactly the obstruction treated here.

## Gonality filtration at n=6

Filter the open stack by gonality and plane-quintic geometry, as in SRC-0004 Section 10.6:

  M^2_6,6 subset M^3_6,6 subset (M^3_6,6 cup PQ_6) subset M_6,6,

where M^k_g,n is the locus of curves admitting a degree-<=k map to P^1, and PQ_n is the preimage of the smooth plane-quintic locus in M_6.

### Stratum 1: hyperelliptic and trigonal (settled for n=6)

SRC-0004 Lemma 9.9: for g>=4 and n<=g+7, the locus M^3_g,n has the CKgP and every Chow class supported on it is tautological. For g=6 one has g+7=13, so n=6 lies strictly inside the published range. Hyperelliptic classes are included (via n<=2g+6=18 for the hyperelliptic CKgP/tautological-support package of Theorem 6.1 / Lemma 9.9). Thus M^3_6,6 contributes no new pure-weight obstruction.

### Stratum 2: plane quintics PQ_6 (settled for n=6)

Plane quintics are the image of G_5,n -> M_6,n. SRC-0004 Lemmas 7.1--7.4 give CKgP of G_d,n and tautological generation of A^*(G_d,n) whenever n<=3d-1. For d=5 this bound is n<=14, so n=6 is safe. The fundamental class of the unpointed plane-quintic locus is tautological by Faber's argument (as used in SRC-0004 Lemma 10.14 / Penev-Vakil); pullback and push-pull then give tautological support of all classes on PQ_6. CKgP of PQ_6 follows from CKgP of G_5,6 (Lemma 7.2) and proper surjectivity (Proposition 4.2(2) / Lemma 3.10 of SRC-0004).

### Stratum 3: generic tetragonal complement (the obstruction)

Write H^4_4,6,n := H_4,6,n \ beta^{-1}(M^3_6,n cup PQ_n) for the Casnati-Ekedahl open of covers with f_1 >=4 (SRC-0004 Definition 10.8 and Lemma 10.10). The published proof that this open has CKgP and that its pushforwards are tautological rests on three interlocking bounds at f=4, g=6:

  n <= 4f - 2g + 1 = 5

(Lemma 10.6 evaluation surjectivity; Lemma 10.11 CKgP of H^f_4,g,n; Lemma 10.12 surjectivity A^*((PE^vee)^n) -> A^*(H^f_4,g,n)). At n=6 the bound fails by exactly one mark.

## Precise degree computation of the evaluation failure

Following the Serre-duality computation in SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6, for W = O_{PE^vee}(2) tensor gamma^* F^vee with F = O(f_1) oplus O(f_2),

  deg(omega_C tensor W_{f_i}|_C^vee (Gamma)) = 4 f_i + n - 2g - 14.

On the generic tetragonal splitting type in genus 6 one has F=(4,5) (so f_1=4, f_2=5). At n=6:

- for f_1=4: degree = 16+6-12-14 = -4 < 0, so H^0 vanishes automatically;
- for f_2=5: degree = 20+6-12-14 = 0.

Thus the evaluation map H^0(PE^vee, W) -> H^0(Gamma, W|Gamma) can fail precisely when the degree-0 line bundle omega_C tensor W_{f_2}|_C^vee (Gamma) is trivial (more generally, has a section). The rewritten uniform bound n <= 4 f_1 - 2g + 1 is forced by the more restrictive summand f_2, and equality n=6 is exactly the first integer where that summand reaches degree 0.

## Attempted repair: independent-conditions stratification of H^4_4,6,6

Define Z subset H^4_4,6,6 to be the closed locus where H^0(C, omega_C tensor W_{f_2}|_C^vee (p_1+...+p_6)) != 0, and set U_ok := H^4_4,6,6 \ Z.

On U_ok the evaluation map is surjective, so the tower

  U_ok subset Y|_{U} -> U subset (PE^vee)^6 -> B

of SRC-0004 (10.10) remains a composition of open immersions and vector/projective bundles over a stack B with CKgP. The standard CKgP lemmas (SRC-0004 3.2--3.8 / SRC-0002 Proposition 4.2) therefore yield CKgP of U_ok, and the same generators as in Lemma 10.12 push forward to tautological classes on the image in M_6,6 \ (M^3_6,6 cup PQ_6) by the FPH / zeta-pushforward package (Proposition 8.4, Lemma 10.5), provided one restricts the domain away from beta^{-1}(PQ_6) as already noted in Lemma 10.14.

## What would finish the argument

If one could show either (i) Z is empty, or (ii) Z has the CKgP and all classes supported on beta(Z) are tautological (or at least algebraic of pure Tate type after cycle class), then excision would give CKgP of the full tetragonal open, hence of M_6,6, and Lemma 4.3 of SRC-0002 would imply that every pure-weight group W_k H^k(M_6,6) is algebraic and pure Hodge-Tate. For even k=16 this would discharge the pure-weight input W_{-16} H^{BM}_{16}(M_6,6) needed by RED-0001 at this single case (still leaving M_3,12, M_5,8, M_7,4, M_8,{0,1,2} untouched).

## Explicit non-claims

- This attempt does not prove CKgP of M_6,6.
- It does not prove W_16 H^{16}(M_6,6) is pure Tate, nor that H^{16}(Mbar_6,6;Q) is a sum of Q(-8).
- No arithmetic point-count prediction, no semisimplification of Galois representations, and no tautological pairing whose perfectness is unproved is used to close any gap.
- Completeness of CONJ-0001 / degree-16 pure Tate for all (g,n) is not claimed from partial base-case progress.
assumptions: Rational coefficients Q throughout; mixed Hodge structures on singular cohomology / Borel-Moore homology of Deligne-Mumford stacks over C, with the usual weight filtration conventions of SRC-0002.

The gonality and Casnati-Ekedahl stratifications of SRC-0004 Sections 9--10 remain valid after adding a sixth marked point (smoothness of the universal curve, allowed splitting types in genus 6, and the identification H^4_4,6,n = H_4,6,n minus beta^{-1}(M^3 cup PQ) of Lemma 10.10).

Standard CKgP permanence under open immersions, proper surjective DM morphisms, finite stratifications, affine/projective/Grassmann bundles, and finite-group gerbes (SRC-0004 Lemmas 3.2--3.10; SRC-0002 Proposition 4.2) is used without change.

The FPH / zeta-pushforward tautologicality statements (SRC-0004 Proposition 8.4, Lemma 10.5) remain valid after restricting domain and target away from the plane-quintic locus, as already invoked in Lemma 10.14.
No appeal is made to Chenevier-Lannes arithmetic predictions, to semisimplifications of Galois representations, or to perfectness of any tautological intersection pairing.
claims: For the triple (g,n,k)=(6,6,16) one has 2g-2+n=k, so W_{-16} H^{BM}_{16}(M_6,6) is a genuine open-stratum base-case input to the boundary exact sequence (6.1) of SRC-0002 and hence to RED-0001.
Published results give CKgP and A^*=R^* for M_6,n only for n<=c(6)=5 (SRC-0002 Table 1; SRC-0004 Lemma 10.14); the case n=6 is outside that range.
The hyperelliptic/trigonal closed locus M^3_6,6 has the CKgP and tautological support for all classes, by SRC-0004 Lemma 9.9 (applicable since 6<=g+7=13).

The plane-quintic locus PQ_6 has the CKgP and tautological support for all classes, by SRC-0004 Lemmas 7.1--7.4 (applicable since 6<=3*5-1=14) together with Faber's tautologicality of the unpointed plane-quintic class.

On the generic tetragonal Casnati-Ekedahl open H^4_4,6,6 with F=(4,5), the Serre-duality degree of omega_C tensor W_{f_2}|_C^vee(Gamma) equals 0 at n=6, so the evaluation-surjectivity hypothesis of SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 is not automatic and is the unique published bound that fails when passing from n=5 to n=6.

On the open U_ok subset H^4_4,6,6 where evaluation remains surjective, the bundle tower (10.10) and the standard CKgP lemmas yield CKgP of U_ok, and the published zeta / FPH pushforward package produces tautological classes on its image in M_6,6 minus (M^3 cup PQ).
CKgP of the residual evaluation-failure locus Z (or a proof that Z is empty), together with control of classes supported on beta(Z), is still required before CKgP of M_6,6 can be concluded.
Even a complete CKgP proof for M_6,6 would, via SRC-0002 Lemma 4.3, only discharge the pure-weight piece at this single (g,n); it would not by itself prove CONJ-0001 for all stable pairs.
gap_markers: GAP-Z-NONEMPTY: It is not proved that the evaluation-failure locus Z subset H^4_4,6,6 is empty. Degree 0 of omega_C tensor W_{f_2}|_C^vee(Gamma) leaves open the possibility that this line bundle is trivial for a positive-dimensional family of pointed covers.

GAP-Z-GEOMETRY: No geometric identification of Z is supplied (e.g. residual linear series, special position of the six points on the scroll, or factorization through a lower-gonality cover). Without such an identification, CKgP and tautological/algebraic generation for classes supported on beta(Z) are unproved.
GAP-Z-CKGP: Even granting a geometric model of Z, the CKgP of Z and of beta(Z) is not established.

GAP-Z-CLASSES: Algebraicity (let alone tautologicality) of arbitrary Chow classes supported on beta(Z) inside M_6,6 \ (M^3_6,6 cup PQ_6) is not established; push-pull from an unknown model of Z does not yet apply.
GAP-EXCISION-GLUE: Excision / stratification gluing of CKgP from M^3_6,6, PQ_6, U_ok, and Z to the whole of M_6,6 is contingent on the previous gaps about Z.

GAP-PURE-WEIGHT-16: W_16 H^{16}(M_6,6) (equivalently W_{-16} H^{BM}_{16}(M_6,6) up to duality/Tate twist) is not proved to be pure Tate or tautological. Lemma 4.3 would give pure Hodge-Tate algebraicity only after CKgP of the full open stack.

GAP-A-EQUALS-R: Even CKgP alone yields pure Tate pure-weight cohomology, not A^*=R^*; the stronger tautological generation A^*(M_6,6)=R^*(M_6,6) is not claimed and is not needed for pure Tate, but is also not proved.

GAP-OTHER-BASE-CASES: This attempt addresses only M_6,6. The RED-0001 list still contains M_3,12, M_5,8, M_7,4, and M_8,n for n=0,1,2, each of which remains an independent obstruction to the degree-16 induction.
GAP-GLOBAL-CONJ: No claim is made that H^{16}(Mbar_g,n;Q) is a direct sum of Q(-8) for all stable (g,n) (CONJ-0001). Partial base-case progress does not close the global induction.

GAP-NO-PAIRING-ESCAPE: The perfectness of the tautological pairing on Mbar_6,6 in complementary degrees is not proved and is not used; computational pairing checks are explicitly disallowed as completeness certificates by the dispatch contract.
